cash_rule.rule: a cash-flagged priced row outside the anchor is cash only where its price (Market Value / Units) is equal, within 1e-4 relative, in the day's partition and in the prior trading day's partition for the same account and CUSIP; otherwise it is OUTSIDE_ANCHOR
cash_rule.not_comparable_treated_as: OUTSIDE_ANCHOR (not cash): the ruling's word is 'only where measured' and a row absent from the prior trading day's partition is unmeasured. The other treatment (not comparable stays cash) is counted beside, under `if_not_comparable_stayed_cash`.
cash_rule.outcome_rule_for_an_account_day: any row whose price differs -> differs; else any row not comparable -> not_comparable; else equal

sixth_reason.treatment: a non-cash row with Units zero and Market Value positive stays a refusal of the stamp; counted as the re-count counted it, nothing changed for it

stores.note: ticker key only; price_kind custodian_mark as grouped by 2.0.0_SA_COO~C2 (msg 5084), though the store's own source column mixes yahoo_finance, linear_interpolation and transaction_observed; it ends 2026-06-09, so it holds the prior-day close of the first graded day and nothing after, and no security can have every needed day from it.
the custodian's own mark on the held position (source bd_snapshot), the same value the source partition carries; NOT an independent close.
a market store; one CUSIP of the ranking has a close here, on one date.
Bloomberg-stored closes by ticker; ends 2026-08-24; a few tickers only.
36 daily CSVs of four ETFs (security column first token); none of the ranked tickers (the key declaration reaches it as declared; the first-token form was also checked: 0 overlap).

local_stores.note: ADVI_COTBKF's derived table (cusip, date, price, store), read-only, another worker's scratch; a DERIVED table whose rows are copies of closes from the stores it names in its own `store` column, so it is not a seventh independent source; not served; not built here.

coverage_basis: a security's needed days are the day and the prior trading day of every account-day it is carried on (distinct dates); its coverage is the union over all six opened stores; the module's match (CUSIP first, ticker second, a reused ticker not credited) decides whether a store answers for it

upper_bound_if_market_close_stores_used_.kind: UPPER BOUND: a found close does not say the holding sits at it; securities with every needed day in the union of the market_close stores; no claim re-graded

upper_bound_if_custodian_mark_stores_als.kind: UPPER BOUND, custodian_mark stores admitted beside the market_close stores: a custodian mark is the same custodian's value of the same holding, not an independent close

upper_bounds_after_the_cash_rule.basis: the ranking with the cash rule's three added securities (not-comparable rows typed OUTSIDE_ANCHOR)

control.fixture: (1) a 4-row fixture parquet read by the census module's own read_store through an in-memory client: FIXA priced on day X (found), FIXB priced only on the next day (not found on X), FIXC priced 0 on X (not a close), and a key nobody asked for (dropped); (2) the cash rule on 3 days, 4 accounts: equal, differs, absent-prior and inside-tolerance cases with the claim of each known by construction.
